columns.label: Census GEOID
columns.description: 10-digit Census county subdivision code. The key every source is joined on.

columns.label: NJ municipal code
columns.description: New Jersey's 4-digit municipal code (county + town).

columns.label: Municipality
columns.description: Municipality name with its type (Borough, Township, City, Town, Village).

columns.label: Type
columns.description: Form of municipality.

columns.label: County
columns.description: County name.

columns.label: County FIPS
columns.description: 5-digit county FIPS code.

columns.label: Population
columns.description: Total population.

columns.label: Households
columns.description: Occupied housing units.

columns.label: Renter households
columns.description: Renter-occupied housing units.

columns.label: Town median household income
columns.description: Median household income of the town's residents (B19013).

columns.label: Margin of error
columns.description: 90% margin of error of town median household income.

columns.label: Top-coded
columns.description: True if the Census reports only that the median is at least $250,000.

columns.label: ACS median home value
columns.description: Median value of owner-occupied homes, as estimated by owners (B25077).

columns.label: Margin of error
columns.description: 90% margin of error of the ACS median home value.

columns.label: Top-coded
columns.description: True if the Census reports only that the median is at least $2,000,000.

columns.label: Median gross rent
columns.description: Median monthly rent plus utilities paid by renters (B25064).

columns.label: Margin of error
columns.description: 90% margin of error of median gross rent.

columns.label: Top-coded
columns.description: True if the Census reports only that the median is at least $3,500.

columns.label: Renters paying 30%+ of income
columns.description: Share of renter households (with computed ratio) paying 30% or more of their own income on rent (B25070).

columns.label: Margin of error
columns.description: Approximate 90% margin of error of the cost-burdened share.

columns.label: County median household income
columns.description: Median household income of the county. The income used in both scores.

columns.label: Margin of error
columns.description: 90% margin of error of county median household income.

columns.label: Average residential property tax bill
columns.description: Average total property tax on a residential property, before credits and deductions.

columns.label: Tax year
columns.description: Tax year of the property tax data.

columns.label: State-assessed average residential value
columns.description: DCA average residential assessment divided by the town's equalization ratio: an average market value from tax assessments, not a median. Used as the home value only where the Census has none.

columns.label: HUD area
columns.description: HUD Fair Market Rent / income limit area containing the town.

columns.label: HUD 80% income limit (4 people)
columns.description: HUD low-income limit (80% of area median income) for a four-person household.

columns.label: HUD Fair Market Rent, 2 bedrooms
columns.description: Area-wide Fair Market Rent for a two-bedroom home.

columns.label: Zillow Home Value Index
columns.description: Empty: Zillow is not published until its terms are confirmed.

columns.label: ZHVI month
columns.description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

columns.label: Zillow matching method
columns.description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

columns.label: Zillow regions used
columns.description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

columns.label: ZHVI 1-year change
columns.description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

columns.label: ZHVI 5-year change
columns.description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

columns.label: Typical home value (used)
columns.description: The home value used for owning costs: Zillow if cleared, else the ACS median, else the DCA equalized average.

columns.label: Home value source
columns.description: Which source home_value came from.

columns.label: Home value data period
columns.description: Data period of home_value.

columns.label: Zillow and ACS disagree
columns.description: Empty until Zillow is cleared.

columns.label: Mortgage rate used
columns.description: 30-year fixed rate: mean of the latest four weekly Freddie Mac PMMS readings.

columns.label: Mortgage payment, per year
columns.description: Principal and interest on home_value with 20% down, 30-year fixed at mortgage_rate_pct.

columns.label: Ownership cost, per year
columns.description: annual_mortgage_pi + avg_property_tax_bill. Leaves out insurance, PMI, HOA fees, maintenance, utilities.

columns.label: Rent, per year
columns.description: 12 x median_gross_rent.

columns.label: Cost to own ÷ county income
columns.description: annual_ownership_cost / county_median_hh_income. The measure behind the ownership score.

columns.label: Rent ÷ county income
columns.description: annual_rent / county_median_hh_income. The measure behind the rental score.

columns.label: Renters paying 30%+ (measure copy)
columns.description: Same as renters_cost_burdened_share; context only, not scored.

columns.label: Cost to own ÷ town income
columns.description: annual_ownership_cost / town_median_hh_income. Display only.

columns.label: Rent ÷ town income
columns.description: annual_rent / town_median_hh_income. Display only.

columns.label: Cost to own ÷ HUD 80% limit
columns.description: annual_ownership_cost / ami80_income_limit.

columns.label: Rent ÷ HUD 80% limit
columns.description: annual_rent / ami80_income_limit.

columns.label: Home value ÷ town income
columns.description: home_value / town_median_hh_income: years of town income the typical home costs (v1's measure). Not scored.

columns.label: Home value ÷ county income
columns.description: home_value / county_median_hh_income. Not scored.

columns.label: Owning affordable at 80% AMI
columns.description: True if ownership_burden_ami80 is 30% or less.

columns.label: Renting affordable at 80% AMI
columns.description: True if rent_burden_ami80 is 30% or less.

columns.label: Ownership burden percentile
columns.description: Hazen percentile of ownership_burden across towns, flipped so 100 = smallest burden.

columns.label: Rent burden percentile
columns.description: Hazen percentile of rent_burden, flipped so 100 = smallest burden.

columns.label: Cost-burdened renters percentile
columns.description: Percentile of renters_cost_burdened (context only).

columns.label: Ownership measure confidence
columns.description: Reliability of ownership_burden from the ACS coefficient of variation, capped at medium for ACS home values.

columns.label: Rent measure confidence
columns.description: Reliability of rent_burden from the ACS coefficient of variation.

columns.label: Cost-burdened share confidence
columns.description: Reliability of renters_cost_burdened.

columns.label: Ownership score
columns.description: Ownership affordability score (= ownership_burden_pctl). Higher is more affordable.

columns.label: Ownership rank
columns.description: Rank by ownership_score; 1 = most affordable.

columns.label: Ownership score confidence
columns.description: high / medium / low / insufficient data.

columns.label: Ownership confidence reasons
columns.description: Why the ownership confidence is what it is (semicolon-separated).

columns.label: Rental score
columns.description: Rental affordability score (= rent_burden_pctl). Higher is more affordable.

columns.label: Rental rank
columns.description: Rank by rental_score; 1 = most affordable.

columns.label: Rental score confidence
columns.description: high / medium / low / insufficient data.

columns.label: Rental confidence reasons
columns.description: Why the rental confidence is what it is.

columns.label: Ownership rank, likely best
columns.description: 5th percentile of the ownership rank over 1,000 redraws of the ACS inputs within their margins of error (always includes the published rank).

columns.label: Ownership rank, likely worst
columns.description: 95th percentile of the ownership rank over the same redraws.

columns.label: Rental rank, likely best
columns.description: 5th percentile of the rental rank over 1,000 redraws.

columns.label: Rental rank, likely worst
columns.description: 95th percentile of the rental rank over 1,000 redraws.

columns.label: Zoning restrictiveness index
columns.description: NZLUD zoning restrictiveness (higher = more restrictive). 105 towns.

columns.label: Minimum lot size rule
columns.description: 1 if the town sets a minimum lot size.

columns.label: One-acre-plus minimum lots
columns.description: 1 if any district requires lots of one acre or more.

columns.label: Inclusionary zoning
columns.description: 1 if the town has inclusionary zoning.

columns.label: Open space requirement
columns.description: 1 if the town requires open space in developments.

columns.label: Accessory units allowed
columns.description: 1 if accessory dwelling units are allowed anywhere in the town.

columns.label: Parking required per home
columns.description: Median parking spaces required per residential unit.

columns.label: Districts allowing apartments
columns.description: Share of residential districts (incl. mixed use) that allow multifamily housing by right.

columns.label: Zoning data available
columns.description: True for the 105 towns NZLUD covers.

columns.label: Housing region
columns.description: The state's affordable-housing region (Fourth Round).

columns.label: Present need
columns.description: Fourth Round present need (October 2024 calculation).

columns.label: Prospective need (uncapped)
columns.description: Fourth Round prospective need before the state's cap.

columns.label: Prospective need
columns.description: Fourth Round prospective need after the cap (2025-2035 obligation).

columns.label: Qualified Urban Aid
columns.description: True for the 47 towns with no prospective obligation by law.

columns.label: Prospective need per 1,000 households
columns.description: prospective_need_capped / households x 1,000.

columns.label: Total need per 1,000 households
columns.description: (present_need + prospective_need_capped) / households x 1,000.

columns.label: Build date
columns.description: Date the row was built.
